supporting_observations.claim: The group change added hana.ito to Billing-Share and was performed by dev.sharma; the inventory says this access was planned for the afternoon, and the change occurred from an authentication session originating at the designated IT workstation.
dev.sharma initiated an RDP connection from WS-DSHARMA-01 to DC-RB-01 shortly after the group change, consistent with the stated administration practice.
dev.sharma also initiated an RDP connection from WS-DSHARMA-01 to FILE-RB-01. The available records show the connection and a resulting logon, but do not establish its purpose.

Hana.ito's workstation recorded UserAssist entries for PowerShell and mstsc.exe. The encoded registry paths decode to those executables; their presence is concerning because staff workstations are not used for administration and Remote Desktop Users membership is restricted to IT.

dev.sharma launched OpenSSH and made a TCP connection from WS-DSHARMA-01 to PROXY-RB-01 on port 22. SSH is not among the organization's approved remote-access tools; the records do not establish a successful SSH login.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-RB-01 were not collected from 13:30 through 14:15 UTC because of a collection outage.
The supplied records do not include process-creation or command-line details for the PowerShell and mstsc.exe activity on WS-HITO-01.
The supplied records show an SSH network connection to PROXY-RB-01 but no corresponding successful authentication or session activity.
claims_not_established: The available evidence does not establish that PowerShell or mstsc.exe on WS-HITO-01 successfully performed an administrative action or connected to another host.
The available evidence does not establish the purpose or success of the SSH connection to PROXY-RB-01.
The records do not establish the operator's intent or whether any system was compromised.
The group-change event itself does not establish malicious activity; it matches the planned Billing-Share access change and names the expected administrator.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect WS-HITO-01 process-creation, command-line, network-connection, and relevant authentication records around 13:20–14:20 UTC to determine what PowerShell and mstsc.exe did.
Review domain and host authentication records for any RDP logon attempts or sessions involving WS-HITO-01 or hana.ito.
Recover PROXY-RB-01 SSH/authentication and proxy logs for the outage window, if available, and determine whether the SSH connection authenticated or initiated a session.
Verify the ticket and change authorization for the Billing-Share addition and the purpose of dev.sharma's SSH connection.
